title: Cisco ThousandEyes Virtual Appliance DHCP Client Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Cisco ThousandEyes Virtual Appliance. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the processing of DHCP client configuration data. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
addtionnal_details:
Cisco has issued an update to correct this vulnerability. More details can be found at:
https://sec.cloudapps.cisco.com/security/center/content/CiscoSecurityAdvisory/cisco-sa-teva-os-command-W4GAO6jp
